title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 10 — WORLD 5: C2 SYSTEMS THINKING, RESEARCH & FUTURE INNOVATION
grammar: Complex sentence architecture with embedded clauses and controlled information density
Advanced aspect, modality, and stance in analytical and speculative discourse
Conditionals, mixed hypotheticals, and counterfactual systems reasoning
Participial clauses, reduced relatives, and non-finite structures for concise prose
Cohesion through reference, substitution, ellipsis, lexical chains, and discourse markers
Nominalisation, abstraction, and compression in research-oriented writing
Qualification, evidential language, and uncertainty management in complex claims
Register shifts between technical, academic, professional, and public-facing communication
